name: Debt-Cycle Phase Detection → Equity Exposure Sizing
description: Replace traditional valuation metrics (P/E, CAPE) with Dalio's debt-cycle phase classifier (early/mid/late/deleveraging). Size equity exposure inversely to late-cycle proximity. Multi-year hold as cycle phases last 5-10+ years.
logic: Late debt cycles precede large equity drawdowns by 1-3 years. React by cutting exposure when debt/GDP, interest coverage, and credit impulse all signal late stage.

name: Cross-Asset Risk Parity Rotation via Wu Wei Gates
description: Replace All Weather static weights with wu-wei-gated dynamic rebalancing: only rebalance when regime shifts are confirmed by 3+ cross-asset signals (equities, bonds, commodities, credit, VIX). Otherwise do nothing.
logic: Varma's non-forcing + Dalio's environment-based allocation. Reduces whipsaw, captures persistent regime shifts lasting 18+ months.

name: 200DMA Risk Asymmetry × Debt Burden Composite
description: Combine Varma's 200DMA regime (above/below) with Dalio's debt burden indicator (debt service ratio, household leverage). 4-state matrix: low debt + above MA = max size; high debt + below MA = flat/short.
logic: Risk asymmetry is amplified when debt burdens high. Multi-year edge as debt cycles unfold slowly.

name: Sentiment Exhaustion × Long-Cycle Anomaly Momentum
description: Layer sentiment extremes (AAII, put/call, news tone) onto long-horizon anomalies (value, quality, profitability). Only enter long-horizon anomaly trades when sentiment is NOT at euphoria extremes.
logic: Long-horizon anomalies persist but suffer during sentiment bubbles. Filtering entry timing extends edge lifespan.

name: Institutional Liquidity Preference × Multi-Year Holding Arb
description: Institutions avoid illiquid, long-horizon value stocks. Build portfolio of illiquid value + quality names, hold 3+ years. Capture liquidity premium + fundamental mean reversion institutions can't access.
logic: Research shows institutions trade wrong direction on long-horizon anomalies due to liquidity constraints. Exploit this structural behavior.

name: Control Theory PID for Portfolio Heat
description: Adapt PID controller from engineering: P = current DD vs target, I = cumulative regime stress days, D = rate of vol increase. Output = leverage scalar (0-2x). Recompute weekly.
logic: Varma's reactive ethos + control theory. Smooths risk adjustments, avoids binary on/off whipsaw.

name: Kuzushi (Off-Balance) Detection in Crowded Themes
description: Adapt martial arts kuzushi principle: identify when a crowded theme (AI, crypto, whatever) shows first signs of instability (declining breadth, rising intra-sector correlation, parabolic extensions). Enter short only when 'off-balance' confirmed, hold 12-18 months.
logic: Themes take years to build, months to crack. Catching the kuzushi moment (crowd tipping point) yields multi-R shorts.

name: CDAP-Weighted Strategy Allocation
description: Instead of equal $ to strategies, allocate based on each strategy's CDAP score (return / regime-weighted-DD). Recompute annually. Starve strategies with bad CDAP (high DD in benign regimes).
logic: Varma's CDAP directly applied to multi-strategy books. Rewards context-aware performance, punishes sloppy execution in safe regimes.

name: Fractional Kelly by Debt-Cycle × Valuation Regime
description: Modify Kelly fraction based on 2D regime: [early/mid/late debt cycle] × [cheap/fair/rich valuation]. Early + cheap = 0.7 Kelly; late + rich = 0.2 Kelly.
logic: Varma uses fractional Kelly; Dalio tracks debt cycles. Combining both modulates risk-taking across macro environments lasting years.

name: Overnight Anomaly as Macro Risk Barometer
description: Instead of trading overnight premium directly, use the *magnitude* of overnight vs intraday returns as a real-time stress indicator. When overnight premium spikes >2 std dev, it signals elevated gap/news risk → reduce equity exposure for 3-6 months.
logic: Varma noted overnight anomaly exists but hard to exploit. Repurpose it as a regime signal, not a trade.

name: Round-Number Resistance as Secular Bull/Bear Inflection
description: Major psychological levels (SPX 1000, 2000, 3000, 5000) act as multi-year inflection points. Use cluster analysis: if index stalls at major round for 6+ months with rising sentiment, it's late cycle. Reduce long bias for 1-2 years.
logic: Round numbers cluster orders; at multi-year highs they become structural supply zones. When broken cleanly, bull extends; when rejected repeatedly, distribution phase.

name: Zero-Forecasting Multi-Year Trend Portfolio
description: Eliminate all return forecasts. Build portfolio purely on: (1) 200+ day MA trend, (2) debt-cycle phase, (3) cross-asset confirmation. If all 3 align bullish, hold 100% equities; if 2/3, hold 50%; if 1/3, flat. Rebalance quarterly, hold for years.
logic: Varma: 'Stop predicting.' Dalio: 'Balance across environments.' Pure reactive system, no alpha models.

name: Remove Intra-Trade Discretion (Wu Wei Execution)
description: Eliminate all mid-trade adjustments. Define entry, stop, target, and time stop (e.g., 2-year max hold) at trade inception. No override allowed. Track performance by 'process adherence.'
logic: Varma's worst trade (Seagate) was marred by discretionary overrides. Wu wei enforcement prevents emotional hijacking on long holds.

name: Inverse Institutional Flow on Long-Horizon Anomalies
description: Research shows institutions trade *against* long-horizon anomalies (value, quality) due to liquidity preference. Build strategy that buys what institutions are net selling (illiquid value) and sells what they're buying (liquid growth), hold 3+ years.
logic: Explicitly exploit documented institutional behavior error. Multi-year as reversion takes time.

name: Reverse Time Preference: Only Enter When 3+ Year Thesis Clear
description: Most traders optimize for 3-12 month trades. Reverse: only enter when you can articulate a 3+ year structural thesis (demo shift, debt cycle, tech adoption curve). Ignore shorter opportunities.
logic: Varma pivoted to >1 year to escape crowding. Dalio thinks in cycles. Forced long-horizon filter reduces competition and behavioral noise.

name: Rearrange: Risk State First, Signal Second
description: Reverse typical flow (scan for setups → check risk). Instead: compute daily risk state (regime matrix), *then* only scan for setups allowed under that state. In high-risk, scan for nothing → wu wei.
logic: Varma's central thesis: make risk primary. Rearranging order enforces discipline, prevents forcing trades in bad regimes.

name: Chaos Constraints + Regime Boundaries
description: Varma used chaos theory to find 'constraints' (restoring forces). Combine with Dalio's regime boundaries: model long-term fair value bands for assets using productivity growth + debt capacity. When asset trades >2 std dev outside band in late debt cycle, fade with multi-year short.
logic: Chaos has attractors; regimes have equilibrium. When both signal extreme, mean reversion is structural, not statistical.

name: Cyber Incident Playbook for Market Dislocations
description: Adapt cybersecurity incident response to market: define 'market incidents' (flash crash, correlation spike, liquidity freeze). Pre-code playbooks with exact actions (cut to 30%, widen stops, pause new entries). Trigger automatically, review weekly.
logic: Reactive frameworks from other domains. Removes emotion during crises, which can define multi-year performance.

name: Sentiment × Debt Cycle Matrix with Time Decay
description: 4-state regime: [early/late debt] × [low/high sentiment]. Assign base exposure (100% / 75% / 50% / 25%). Add time-decay: if stuck in same state >18 months, reduce by 10% (acknowledging regime staleness).
logic: Regimes persist but eventually break. Time decay prevents complacency in stale regimes.

name: No Trades in Neutral Regimes (Shi Absence)
description: Define 'neutral' as: price near 200MA, vol mid-range, correlation mid-range, sentiment neutral, debt-cycle mid. Eliminate all trading when neutral (no positional advantage / shi). Only trade extremes.
logic: Martial shi concept: only act when advantage clear. Neutral = no edge = wu wei.
